beats.acting: Agnes offers a formal greeting while giving the unfamiliar man her measured attention.
Will returns the greeting and settles his attention on Agnes, encouraged by the opening.
Her direct question carries genuine curiosity beneath the politeness.
Naming his position makes Will newly conscious of how little he belongs here.
Recognition sharpens Agnes's scrutiny as she studies the tutor she has heard about.
The question catches Will unprepared; he hesitates and briefly avoids her eyes while searching for an answer.
Agnes lightly needles him, making clear that her question was simple while testing how he will respond.
Will gathers his thoughts, glancing away momentarily as he searches for a plausible explanation.
Mentioning the bird draws Will's attention toward the hawk, giving him a safer subject than his own motives.
Agnes corrects him with quiet certainty, redirecting the conversation toward the creature she knows well.
